head: Inviting You: affirmation app that loops your own voice with tones
dek: Inviting You is a new $4.99 iPhone and iPad app that records your own affirmations or self-talk and plays them on repeat over a binaural or isochronic tone. It was #71 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on November 11.
details: The tones are tuned to alpha, theta or delta waves, and you can add a real rain or ocean recording underneath. Recordings are saved on the device and can be renamed, downloaded or imported. Binaural tones need headphones; isochronic tones work through the speaker. The maker, Fly Fearless Unlimited LLC, says the app collects no data and has no account, analytics or ads.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later), $4.99, no in-app purchases listed
means: If you like listening to affirmations, this app lets you use your own voice instead of someone else's, for a one-time price.
todo: Read the listing first; keep headphones handy if you want the binaural tones.
